title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Billing Computation Note — Amount of the Statement Late Payment Charge
content:
**Clause.** The late payment charge for a closed statement of a Ridgeline Pro Credit commercial account is the statement's past-due amount times the tier's monthly late payment charge percentage divided by one hundred, rounded to the nearest cent, and never less than the tier's minimum late payment charge when the past-due amount is above zero.

## Inputs

| Input | Where it comes from |
|---|---|
| Past-due amount | The past-due amount printed on the account's latest closed statement |
| Statement period and statement date | The same statement |
| Monthly late payment charge percentage | The account's tier, per the Ridgeline Pro Credit fee schedule |
| Minimum late payment charge | The account's tier, per the same schedule |

The charge is computed only for a statement on which a late payment charge is owed: the latest closed statement, showing more days past due than the tier's late charge grace days, with no late payment charge yet carrying its period.

## Worked examples (hypothetical statements)

| Tier | Past-due amount | Percentage | Past-due amount times percentage, divided by one hundred | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Commercial Account Net 30 | 3456.78 | 2.00 | 69.1356 | 69.14 |
| Commercial Account Net 45 | 9120.00 | 1.50 | 136.80 | 136.80 |
| Commercial Account Net 30 Select | 80.00 | 1.75 | 1.40 | 2.00 (the minimum) |

## Basis Q&A

**Does the minimum apply when the computed amount is small?** Yes. When the past-due amount is above zero, the charge is never less than the tier's minimum late payment charge: 2.00 on the Net 30 and Net 30 Select, 5.00 on the Net 45 and Net 60 Enterprise.

**What is rounded?** The computed amount, to the nearest cent.
